scope: Source-level transaction and failure-boundary checks for operator report-review reads

verified: Report queue establishes operator tenant context on the same connection before its bounded SELECT.
Report detail establishes operator tenant context on the same connection before its payload-bounded SELECT.
Both SQL reads retain location-qualified operator grants and database grant rechecks.
Tenant-context denial prevents the report SELECT and rolls back/closes the connection for queue and detail paths.
Oversized report detail is rejected and the read-only transaction is rolled back and closed.

limitations: Connections and tenant-context setup are synthetic; no PostgreSQL query or signed context function was executed.
This does not establish owner/share provisioning, final runtime-role privileges, application-table RLS, or populated report parity.
No candidate, legacy, Directus, identity-provider, or external provider was accessed.
